title: Temporary preview — 33-corner complete loop
rationale: Noisy sensors and EKF feed the planner, Pure Pursuit, longitudinal control, ABS, TC and ESC. Blue: actual car; orange dotted outline: estimated pose. Lap: 191.074 s; maximum path error: 0.505 m; position estimation RMSE: 0.154 m. Selected reduced Q is unchanged.
detail: Temporary access copy · normal speed · actual and estimated pose · 20 fps

title: ESC V1 — moose manoeuvre in 3D
rationale: Blue: ESC; translucent orange: no ESC. Perfect-state test, 13 m transitions and a 20 m/s reference; nominal braking is suppressed. ESC reduces maximum sideslip to 1.88° and completes, with three cone contacts.
detail: Normal speed · fixed-orientation tracking camera · 25 fps

title: ESC V1 — 2D manoeuvre comparison
rationale: The same 13 m-transition perfect-state test as the 3D recording. Compare both trajectories, sideslip, yaw rate and speed. ESC stabilizes and completes but still contacts three cones.
detail: Normal speed · simultaneous ESC on/off · 20 fps

title: Modulated ABS off versus on — TC on in both
rationale: Same fourteen-corner track, TC, noisy sensors and EKF in both cases. Only ABS changes: off versus new 0.98/0.80 release–hold–rebuild modulation. Both complete the lap.

title: Modulated ABS and TC on — actual versus estimated
rationale: Actual and estimated positions superposed, with speed and error traces. Selected working reduced Q; sensor noise, R, P0 and EKF equations unchanged. Maximum path error 0.354 m.

title: Retained moose-style test 02 — failed manoeuvre
rationale: Checks the functional boundary with ESC: TC limits driving demand but lateral instability remains possible. Pure Pursuit, fixed 20 m/s target; ABS enabled without braking. Sensors, estimator and ESC omitted. Failed manoeuvre; only test 02 retained.
detail: Normal speed · fixed reference, failed tracking
